questions.question: Is the main subject clearly a frazzled office worker in business casual buried at a desk beneath an avalanche of glowing holographic chat bubbles and red notification badges?
Is the subject depicted typing frantically on three keyboards at once while chat bubbles swirl overhead?
Does the overall style read as 'glossy live-action premium commercial photography, crisp lighting, comedic timing, shallow depth of field, 16:9 cinematic still'?
Is all visible text crisp, correctly spelled, and non-garbled?
Is the image free of watermarks, logos, or signatures that were not requested?
